01About us

Filmmakers who think like marketers.

Coastline Films is a video and photo production company based in Squamish, BC. We make brand films, commercials and content for companies that want to look like the best in their category, and sell like it.

We run every project from concept to final cut: strategy, direction, cinematography, aerial, underwater and post-production. One vision and one standard, start to finish.

Small on purpose. You work directly with the filmmakers, every step of the way. No account managers. No hand-offs. Nothing lost in translation. At the core, it's family: founder Jacob DeGrace, his brother Brodie and their cousin Pierre-Luc Arseneau.

02Our mission

High-end visuals that make your brand the obvious choice.

People judge what you sell by how it looks. They see your feed, your website and your ads, and decide what you're worth before they read a word. Average visuals get you compared on price. Exceptional visuals let you set it.

Our mission is to give ambitious brands visuals that match the quality of what they deliver: cinematic films, commercials and content that build trust on sight, hold attention in a crowded feed and move people to book, buy or call. We pair the craft of filmmaking with the discipline of advertising, so every frame earns its place.

03Our culture

You can't fake being out there.

Coastline was built on a simple conviction: the best work in the outdoor, travel and lifestyle space comes from people who actually live it. Audiences can tell the difference. So we built a crew whose time off looks a lot like our clients' best marketing.

Jacob DeGrace has lived aboard sailboats, travelled to more than 50 countries, hiked his share of mountains and logged over 100 solo skydives. Brodie DeGrace is a Divemaster with more than 1,000 dives, a surfer and a climber who has lived all over the world. Pierre-Luc Arseneau is a professional mountain biker, fully sponsored by Kona Bikes.

We work, play and live at the same intensity. That standard is why we're at home where most crews aren't, and why the work looks the way it does.

FAQ

Common questions.

How do I book a call?

Answer a few quick questions in the booking box above, then pick a time. It's a free 30-minute call over Google Meet. Prefer email? Send the basics to info@coastlinefilms.ca and we'll reply within one business day.

How much does video production cost?

Every project is quoted to scope. In BC, a solo videographer typically runs $1,200 to $3,000 per day and a small crew $3,000 to $7,000 per day. In Ontario it's $1,000 to $2,500 and $2,500 to $6,000. All prices in CAD. Get a number in under a minute with the video production cost calculator, or read the full breakdown for Vancouver and BC or Ontario.

Where are you based, and where do you shoot?

We're based in Squamish, BC. We shoot across the Sea to Sky, Metro Vancouver and Vancouver Island, and across Muskoka, Toronto and the rest of Ontario. We also regularly travel for work, Canada-wide and beyond.

How long does a project take?

A social shoot can be turned around in one to two weeks. A brand film or commercial usually takes four to eight weeks from kickoff to delivery. We confirm your timeline on the first call.

Do you offer monthly content retainers?

Yes. Scheduled shoot days every month and a steady flow of edited reels and photos for social and ads. It's the most cost-effective way to stay visible all year. Retainers start at $1,800 per month, CAD. See what's included in a monthly content retainer.

Do you shoot outside Canada?

Yes. We regularly travel for work, Canada-wide and beyond. Jacob has filmed as far afield as Panama on the Parlay Revival sailing series. Tell us where and we'll handle the logistics. You can also browse our recent work.

  var EASE = 0.09;

    var dy = Math.max(r.top  - my, 0, my - r.bottom);

    var rotX=0, rotY=0, rotXT=0, rotYT=0, raf=null;

        rotXT = -dy * max * s;

      }
